newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Evening up expected ahead of Cattle-on-Feed report. Beef remains weak.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Positioning ahead of report. Index little lower and corn called higher.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.200 to 0.250 cent. Carryover seen on lower hog indications and declining pork values.
PORK BELLIES - Off 1.500 to 2.500 cent. Carryover from limit losses, lower product and larger than year ago demand.
